description: This source file defines a PHP class Banner within the Opencart admin controller namespace. The class contains methods to add, edit, and delete banners by scheduling tasks via a model call. It acts as an event listener or handler for banner-related events in the Opencart e-commerce platform.

classes.name: Banner
classes.description: Controller class for handling banner-related events, such as add, edit, and delete banner actions. It schedules corresponding tasks based on banner events.

methods.name: addBanner
methods.description: Schedules a task to add a new banner, triggered after a banner is added. Uses output parameter to determine banner ID and creates a task for banner info.

methods.name: editBanner
methods.description: Schedules a task to update banner information, triggered after a banner edit. Uses argument array to determine banner ID.

methods.name: deleteBanner
methods.description: Schedules a task to delete a banner, triggered after a banner deletion. Uses argument array to identify the banner to delete.
